Claim: PM loop round 2 · 2026-10-21T00:47Z · p1, `domain:engine` (ruling B on #24932, 6303721609, card (b)(i)). The engine composes the ReadableIds leaf for a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller, intersected with the delegator's own scope, instead of refusing it; the ADR-0139 revision (O5 answered, D5.1 amended) rides this PR.
Session: `session_01QK6pdbxKZiHdFApL8RYVh9` (the dispatching seat; the dev is a `mode:subagent` run of this session, told apart by its branch)
Account: `os-support-ai` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-25009-readable-ids-delegated-compose`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-25009`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#2` (seat post #20966)
Ruling-ref: 6303721609 (read at this claim)
File surface:
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, the ReadableIds leaf composition only: the delegated-caller refusal (`for a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller: …`, read at `:6225` on `62bc12930`) becomes a composition intersected with the delegator's scope (ADR-0139 D10).
- `docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md`: O5 answered yes in the ruling's end-state form; D5.1 amended to the composition built here. Governed (Tier H): the PR stays a draft for the maintainer's approval.
- Pins in `packages/objectql`'s tests beside the existing leaf tests: a delegated read composes and returns exactly the rows the delegator intersection allows; the closed doors stay closed. With ablation.
- A changeset for `@objectstack/objectql`.

⛔ Not in scope: the nested master chain (#25010, serial after this card in the same region); plugin-security's switch and the id-list pre-scan's retirement (#24932, card (c)); ADR-0055's text; any spec key.
If the federated-master or the middleware-narrowed-master refusal (read near the same lines) blocks "once for every shape", the dev reports it as a fork on this card and does not choose.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (ceiling; reason: a security read-scope composition, the delegator intersection, plus a governed ADR revision; this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (an engine-internal leaf, not a published accept set; the runtime read-scope change is the human floor's, decided by ruling 6303721609)
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists were read at this claim. PR #25016 (`engine.ts` near `:19596`, `:19954`) and PR #24893 (near `:91`, `:9043`, `:12187`) hold other regions; no open PR touches the leaf region or ADR-0139. #25010 waits for this card.
